evals.prompt: Set the quality bar for this repo and make CI actually enforce it — coverage, security scanning, the works.
evals.expected_output: Should route to floor-it. Should detect current values, freeze a numbered CONSTRAINTS table (one-way gate), wire one tool per dimension, prove each gate fires on an injected violation (RED) then restore (GREEN), enforce in CI, and terminate FLOORED or FLOORED-WITH-PARKED (untoolable dimensions parked with a named human gate).
assertions: Freezes a numbered dimension x threshold table as the denominator
One tool per dimension, wired on unit branches
Every gate proven RED on an injected violation before it blocks CI
Untoolable dimensions are parked, never given a vacuous check

evals.prompt: Close the test gap on the payments critical path.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to floor-it. Test coverage of critical paths is one dimension of a bar; closing test debt is prove-it. floor-it installs the standing, multi-dimensional, tool-enforced bar.
assertions: Distinguishes one dimension (tests) from the whole quality bar

evals.prompt: Prove SOC 2 conformance with an audit-ready evidence pack.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to floor-it. Conformance to an external framework's obligation set is attest-it. floor-it's bar is the repo's own chosen constraints, machine-enforced.
assertions: Distinguishes a self-imposed enforced bar from an external standard's obligations

evals.prompt: Set the quality bar for this repo and make CI enforce it. CI is red right now: coverage is 72% against fail_under = 80 in pyproject.toml.
evals.expected_output: Should measure current values with the repo's own counters, draft the dimension x threshold table, and treat the thresholds as a one-way freeze the human owns. The red coverage gate is the bar working: lowering fail_under, or adding coverage omit/exclusions to turn CI green, is the quiet lowering the guard exists to stop.
assertions: Measures current values with the repo's own counters before drafting the bar
Treats thresholds as a one-way human freeze and parks there when no human is available
Refuses to lower fail_under or add exclusions to turn CI green
